p10_b0.ocr: In the 3rd Quarter of 2023, Tencent Holdings reported cybersecurity incidents categorized by Incident Type, with Data Breaches totaling 150 incidents classified as High severity, requiring a Response Time of 24 hours, incurring a Cost Impact of $5M, a Recovery Time of 1 week, and a Financial Impact of $10M, alongside Insurance Claims amounting to $200M and Litigation Costs of N/A. Malware Attacks totaled 80 incidents at Medium severity, with a 12-hour Response Time, $2M Cost Impact, 3- day Recovery Time, Financial Impact of $4M, Insurance Claims of $150M, and Litigation Costs of N/A.

p10_b1.ocr: Phishing Attempts reached 300 incidents at Low severity, requiring a 2-hour Response Time, with a $1M Cost Impact, 1-day Recovery Time, Financial Impact of $2M, Insurance Claims of $50M, and Litigation Costs of N/A. DDoS Attacks accounted for 50 Critical severity incidents with a Response Time of 30 minutes, an $8M Cost Impact, a Recovery Time of 5 days, a Financial Impact of $12M, Insurance Claims of $75M, and Litigation Costs of N/A.
